description: This file implements a web service class for SuiteCRM, extending functionality from a v3.1 base class. It provides methods for user login, retrieving entries, module layouts, searching modules, OAuth token handling, and job queue operations. It orchestrates interactions with CRM modules, performs access checks, and manages session states within the web service API.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv4
classes.description: Implementation of a SOAP web service class for SuiteCRM, handling login, data retrieval, search, OAuth, and job queue management, extending functionalities from a v3_1 base class.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided credentials, initializes session, and returns session details and user preferences.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches specific entries based on IDs from a given module, including relationship data.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of records from a module with filtering, pagination, and relationship data.

methods.name: get_module_layout
methods.description: Returns layout metadata for specified modules, views, and types.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a search across specified modules, returning matching records with detail.

methods.name: job_queue_next
methods.description: Fetches the next job from the queue for a client.

methods.name: job_queue_cycle
methods.description: Runs cleanup and scheduling for the job queue.

methods.name: job_queue_run
methods.description: Executes a specific job from the queue.
